name: single-nucleus RNA-seq demultiplexing benchmarking
description: Evaluates computational demultiplexing methods for single-nucleus RNA-seq by assessing sample-assignment accuracy and downstream impacts on expression analyses.
reputation: Moderately used within the single-cell genomics community for comparing demultiplexing methods and reported in method-comparison studies.
notes: Caveats include ambient RNA and doublet contamination, dependence on genotype/ground-truth labels, dataset-specific biases and variability across protocols, and relatively small / heterogeneous public benchmarking sets; non-LLM benchmark.
